provenance: Original synthetic English scenarios authored by the Codex research_creative agent for this task; no real participants, messages, events or personal data.
unit: One case is a pair of lists. Every expected entry labels the update at update_index against the original plan array, never against another update.

label_policy.source_indexes: All source lines that are legitimate alignment targets. Empty means this update has no corresponding instruction in the original plan.
label_policy.alignment: single = one target; alternatives = ambiguous choice among listed targets; multiple_required = the update touches every listed target; none = no target.
label_policy.ambiguous: True when the update needs interpretation/confirmation before a defensible edit, including conditionality, unresolved reference, contradiction or multiple targets.
label_policy.cancellation: True only when the update cancels a positive original activity/obligation, including an ambiguous target. Negating a cancellation is false.
label_policy.expected_review: A human annotation for inspecting examples, not a predicted action or product automation requirement. replace preserves the exact update text as a replacement; resolve means no unreviewed edit is defensible.
label_policy.warning_labels: Semantic test labels, not a claim a keyword rule can detect every case.

plan: The writing workshop starts at 10:00 on Saturday.
Meet in Room Cedar on the first floor.
Bring a laptop with a charged battery.
The organizer will provide extension leads.
updates: The writing workshop now starts at 10:30 on Saturday.
Meet in Room Maple on the second floor instead.
Please bring a reusable cup.

expected.note: Same workshop start time with an explicit correction.
Replacement room; the floor changes with the room.
New cup requirement. Laptop and extension-lead instructions are distractors.

updates: The badge-making session has been cancelled.
Please bring a bottle of water with you.
A quiet reading area will be available all day.

expected.note: Cancellation aligns to the named session; preserve exact cancellation wording for review.
Paraphrase of an existing instruction with no intended change.
A newly announced facility, not an update to lunch or welcome talk.

plan: The sketching class meets in the courtyard.
updates: If it rains, we may move the class to the library; wait for confirmation.
The class will start at 14:15.
Bring a small folding stool.

expected.note: The venue line is related, but the conditional venue is not confirmed.
Explicit start-time change.
A new item, despite lexical similarity to bring a sketchbook.

plan: Everyone should enter through the east gate.
updates: Workshop instructors should arrive at 08:30 instead.
Participants should enter through the west gate.
The volunteer stewards no longer need to come early; arrive at 09:15.

expected.note: Role attribution matters more than shared arrive wording.
Only participants change entrance; replacing the everyone instruction loses other roles.
Changes the stewards' time, not their participation; it is not event cancellation.

plan: The book pickup is at 15:00 by the front desk.
The equipment pickup is at 15:30 by the rear door.
updates: The pickup is cancelled.
The equipment pickup will use the front desk.
Show your booking confirmation when you arrive.

expected.note: No text identifies which pickup is cancelled.
The noun equipment resolves the target despite a new location matching the book pickup.
Same confirmation requirement in different wording.

plan: Leave bicycles at the side entrance.
updates: Bring a reusable mug.
Leave umbrellas in the lobby.
The event will now finish at 16:30.

expected.note: Different object: bring syntax alone must not imply replacement.
New umbrella instruction does not replace bicycle storage.
Finish and end refer to the same event boundary.

plan: Bring two printed copies of your draft.
updates: Bring three printed copies of your draft instead of two.
The demo session is not cancelled after all.
Do not put bags under your chair; use the cloakroom.

expected.note: Quantity correction must align even when most tokens are identical.
Reinstatement is not a cancellation.
The old bag-storage obligation is explicitly withdrawn and replaced.

updates: The poetry reading starts at 18:00.
Please enter from the north side.
The organizer posted photos of last month's chess tournament.

expected.note: Editorial synonym only.
Same entrance instruction.
Unrelated retrospective announcement has no plan target.

cases.scenario: One update touching multiple original instructions
plan: Both sessions take place in Hall A.
updates: The opening session starts at 09:30 and the closing session starts at 16:30.
Both sessions will take place in Hall B.
Notebooks are no longer needed.

expected.note: One update modifies two source lines. A one-to-one matcher cannot silently replace both.
The shared location was already one source line.
Withdraws the notebook requirement.

cases.scenario: Missing referents and unknown cancelled activity
plan: Meet each guide at the main desk.
updates: That one starts half an hour later.
The evening concert is cancelled.
Meet each guide at the side desk instead.

expected.note: The plan contains two tours; no referent is specified.
Cancellation of an activity absent from the original plan. Do not attach it to a tour.
Explicit change of meeting desk.

usage: Use for development, threshold selection and prompt-free pipeline calibration.
